papers.title: Warm springs and dry summers weaken radial stem growth dependence on primary growth by increasing phenological synchrony between primary and secondary meristems in Pinus taiwanensis
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现导师方向与国家战略；命中“drought、carbon sequestration、subtropical forest、climate change”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract A complete integration of the phenology of primary and secondary meristems is essential for understanding the tree growth trajectories under changing climates and the consequences for carbon sequestration in forest ecosystems.
essence.design: We conducted weekly observations of primary and secondary growth in Taiwan pine (Pinus taiwanensis Hayata) across an elevational gradient in the subtropical forests of southeastern China during 2017-2019, including one year with an extreme drought event.

papers.title: Afforestation enhances ecosystem stability in the farming-pastoral ecotone of northern China, but its effects are constrained by water availability
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现前沿突破与导师方向；命中“drought、recovery”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract The farming-pastoral ecotone of northern China (FPENC), a typical semi-agricultural and semi-pastoral ecologically fragile zone, has long faced controversy over afforestation due to its water-limited environment, raising concerns about how afforestation affects this fragile ecosystem.
essence.design: In this study, based on Google Earth Engine and a Random Forest model, we derive afforestation distribution (1985-2020), and further investigated ecosystem stability under afforestation from the perspectives of short-term responses and long-term dynamic changes.
essence.innovation: This study revealed despite water scarcity and low tree survival, afforestation under suitable precipitation can effectively enhance regional ecosystem stability.

papers.title: Deep learning derived leaf traits reveal phylogenetic and environmental drivers of diversification in Rhododendron
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现跨学科融合；命中“deep learning”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract Leaf traits mediate plant heat and water exchange, driven by evolutionary history and environmental conditions.
essence.design: Multi‐optima Ornstein‐Uhlenbeck (OU) models suggested a small ancestral leaf area and indicated six shifts in adaptive optima, most of which occurred between 30 and 10 Mya.
essence.innovation: Synthesis : This study reveals that the diversity of leaf morphology in Rhododendron is shaped not only by broad evolutionary history and contemporary environment, but also by distinct evolutionary lineages adopting differentiated adaptive strategies within similar environmental niches.
